---
name: Bug report
about: Something read, checked, diffed, or rendered wrong
title: ""
labels: bug
---

## What happened

A clear description of the wrong behavior, and what you expected instead.

## Reproduce

The command you ran (for example `agni check path/to/design.kicad_sch`) and the output.

If you can, attach a small design file that reproduces it. A hand-authored fixture is far
more useful than a confidential design, and lets the fix ship with a regression test.

## Environment

- agni version or commit
- OS and Go version
- Input format (KiCad / EDIF / IPC-2581 / xschem / gEDA)
